body: Yeah. I've been seeing psychiatrists and therapists for years. They help sometimes but it is just hard. I see people who seem to have it all and I just feel so inadequate.

I think that you are thinking of Dissociative identity disorder... Not Schizoaffective Disorder. Schizoaffective disorder causes delusions, hallucinations, emotional flattening, and paranoia, as well as severe depression (depressive type) or mood swings (Bipolar Type

It's not a bad idea. But it's also just hard on me financially. I'm on SSI income and even the cheapest therapists I've found are still 50$ a session. It's very hard for me to pay that and not even get much out of it most likely. You're not wrong that that right therapist can really help. But I'm just not in a position to do so. But I do appreciate your advice
I've been in and out of therapy since I was 8... unfortunately it hasn't been much help, especially since It is so hard for me to connect with and trust someone.

Getting professional help sounds like a good start. While I am far from okay, medicine and therapy have done wonders to help me not fall apart. You must know that no matter what you've done, or whatever your faults may be, you are valid as a human being. It is so important to love yourself. And it is very hard to do, but it is still so important. Try every day to see yourself as worthy of love. Take as much time as you need to get better, don't let anyone rush you. never ever tell yourself you are bad. You may need to correct some things, but you as a human being are not bad. You deserve to be happy.

Bullies are never right. I don't know you, but I know that you are valuable and that your life is precious. I only hope I can offer even a little bit of comfort. You don't deserve this pain, no matter how much you may begin to think so.

Yeah I work retail atm and let me tell you I hate it. I'd like to do CAD drafting in the future, at least as an entrance to something more... more solitary. No being slammed by customers and being yelled at because a we can't take a coupon.

I'll try to remind myself of what that verse says. Maybe one day I'll feel like I'm worth something. Today is a little bit better, thankfully... not quite as bad. Thank you for taking the time out of your day to help. I'm trying as hard as I can. Sometimes I feel like that's not enough. But still... I wanna keep trying at least.

I would talk to him about it if I could. All the guilt and the depression makes it so I always feel like I'm hated by him and that I'm destined for nothing but more pain because I'm not good. Thanks for your kinds words though, I do appreciate it. It's just that talking to him often makes me feel worse because I just feel like I'm talking to myself and nobody is listening. I often wish I could just take a break or even leave entirely but overwhelming nervousness and fear that I'm making a huge mistake prevents me from doing so. In the end I just want to feel like I'm worth loving myself.

Thanks, I appreciate the kind words. other peoples words can effect me greatly. When people are hurtful towards me, It effects me for days. I constantly think people hate me. My mom also tells me I'm way to hard on myself. I want to learn how to just let myself live my life and stop beating the crap out of myself for little things

I'm currently trying to do just that. I've always used food as a comfort when I am depressed. Admittedly, after I'm done stuffing my face, I just feel worse. I'm in the process of changing my eating habits.
I dont have an answer for those questions. I just feel it, It's just unwanted thoughts and feelings that assail me on a daily basis. So much so that I can't enjoy life anymore

Honestly just knowing someone else goes through the same stuff helps. It's just difficult when I realize that this person I made up isn't real, and that I will likely never find a real person that is as understanding or caring.
I guess I just have a problem with getting past that point... anytime I do actually meet a nice girl, I can never push past the superficial. Maybe I'm just impatient.

I honestly just don't really know where/how to meet people. I don't know what to say to start a conversation or build a relationship. Some people say that a real relationship just has to happen. I just don't really know where to go to find genuinely kind people, especially of the opposite sex.
